## Description

Behind the tenant flag ai-notes: Encounters endpoints (capability, tenant, care relationship, recording consent) that open an AI session for an encounter (clinic id = tenant id, patient_ref = encounter id), pass consent, stream audio chunks, finish, and read the draft. Draft SOAP sections fill the consult note sections; each drafted field is listed in UndecidedAi until the doctor accepts or edits it, so signing stays blocked (MDV-P2-044). The browser never calls the AI service; the client is generated from Host.Api's OpenAPI document. web/clinic features/ai-notes: record, progress, review with the evidence quote per field (EN, HI, AR; axe clean). No raw audio in browser storage.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** With the flag off, no AI endpoint is reachable and the note works as today.
- [ ] **AC2.** A draft never signs: every drafted field is undecided until the doctor accepts or edits it; sign is refused while any is undecided.
- [ ] **AC3.** A user of another tenant, or without the care relationship, gets 403/404 on every AI endpoint (integration test against real PostgreSQL with the AI service on fake providers).
- [ ] **AC4.** No transcript or note text appears in logs, URLs or telemetry on either side.
- [ ] **AC5.** Playwright J2 consent-to-sign step passes with the AI service on fake providers; English and Arabic checked in a browser.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
